summary: Independently reproduced the split-CRLF header-index bug and its repair through four public API paths. The unchanged checker failed 96 of 1428 baseline cases while all 44 unsplit controls passed; the exact candidate passed all 1428 cases.
evidence: Derived and saved reproduce-check.cjs from claim.md plus baseline README.md, docs/ASYNC.md and docs/BROWSER.md before reading candidate production changes or tests. Candidate tests were not used to derive or run this checker. The production diff was inspected only after both executions.

Public API documentation: https://github.com/iuccio/csvToJson/blob/ad47fe16eef8d7644cca0087db91ff5766235d3b/README.md ; https://github.com/iuccio/csvToJson/blob/ad47fe16eef8d7644cca0087db91ff5766235d3b/docs/ASYNC.md ; https://github.com/iuccio/csvToJson/blob/ad47fe16eef8d7644cca0087db91ff5766235d3b/docs/BROWSER.md . Documentation was also read from baseline 31e6cda09bb69d462c3ab9d66fa4157b430c1b8d using git show.

Both checks ran via python3 night.py run --checkout .work/checkouts/iuccio-csvToJson-review-reproduce-20261017 --image node:24-bookworm --timeout 240 -- node reproduce-check.cjs. The review checkout was detached at the corresponding exact commit; the only added file was the unchanged checker.
Environment: Node v24.22.0; immutable image sha256:14078204b6bb268c107ceff6d3c43f45a888105e5c2b18b14c32b3409d93a1b0. Commands and image records match before and after.

Eleven explicit-output fixtures cover header offsets 1, 2 and 3; default header; real blank preamble records; mixed standalone CR/LF; CR at EOF; quoted EOF; embedded CR/LF and escaped quotes; disabled quoting; value conversion; row mapping/filtering. Each runs unsplit, at every possible two-chunk cut, one character per chunk, and one character per chunk with two empty chunks after each character.

API paths: Node Readable with string chunks; Node Readable with ASCII Buffer chunks; browser getJsonFromStreamAsync with native Node Web ReadableStream and ASCII Uint8Array chunks; browser getJsonFromFileStreamingAsyncWithCallback using a File subclass whose stream supplies those chunks. Callback onComplete and concatenated onChunk rows are both checked.

Baseline concrete failure: indexHeader(1), chunks ["preamble", "
id,note
1,ok
"] return [] instead of [{"id":"1","note":"ok"}] across all four API paths. The candidate returns the expected row.

Preserved the original helper records and logs without editing; copied public-safe duplicates to evidence/reproduce-before.json, evidence/reproduce-before.log, evidence/reproduce-after.json and evidence/reproduce-after.log. Both retained immutable input snapshots contain the exact saved checker bytes.

git diff --exit-code HEAD passed in the candidate review checkout; git status --short listed only the untracked checker. No candidate source or tests were edited, committed, pushed or published by this reviewer.
limitations: Uses Node Web APIs, not an actual browser engine.
ASCII byte chunks and decoded string chunks only; no claim about split multibyte decoding, malformed CSV, universal CSV conformance, callback timing, or performance.
This reproduction review does not independently rerun the full Jest/lint/docs acceptance suite or Node 22; those remain separate acceptance evidence.
